title: Ground Truth: CISO Matt Martin on Building a Real Security Program Without an Enterprise Budget
description: This content is an interview-style article featuring Matthew Martin, Chief Information Security and Privacy Officer at Western Carolina University, discussing his approach to building a security program with limited budget and resources. It highlights his journey from financial services to higher education, his focus on creativity within constraints, and his emphasis on risk management and automation. The article does not describe a security vulnerability, threat, or exploit.
